result.note: Tested India's 2026 BRICS chairship: the September summit venue and the May Foreign Ministers' Meeting outcome. Putin's attendance itself is only announced, so it is not the tested fact.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about BRICS under India's chairship in 2026:
items: The BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in New Delhi in May 2026 ended without a joint communiqué because members disagreed on language about the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
India, as chair, issued a summary of the May 2026 Foreign Ministers' Meeting.
The BRICS summit is scheduled to be held in New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the ministerial meeting failed to agree on language on the US-Iran conflict, not Russia-Ukraine, so India issued a chair's summary instead. Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said Putin will attend the New Delhi summit, his second trip to India in less than a year.
questions.source: Last week’s ministerial meeting ended without a joint communiqué after members failed to agree on language on the US-Iran conflict.
